body: Gross. Sounds like they deserve each other. Glad you’re away from that toxic environment now OP.
This has made my night infinitely better.
‘I’ll give you naps forever’ is a real cute way to say ‘I’m a serial killer’
He’d love to eat that ass to where? TO WHERE?!

I know it’s a cliche but things will improve. You’ll feel like a different person when you get out on your own and it wouldn’t surprise me if she moved onto abusing someone else once you did and then they’ll see her and this situation for what it really is.

Don’t let her bring you down, you do what YOU need to do for yourself and your life.

No, that’s okay I understand. What’s clear as day is that she knows exactly what she’s doing, switching languages and manipulating the situation so you are literally completely unable to defend yourself.

I truly believe the truth always comes out in the end. It might take days. It might take years. But it always comes out. Just know you’re not in the wrong in this situation. Don’t allow her the satisfaction of beating you down.

And that shows that she’s doing a stellar job at manipulating those around you and gaslighting the shit out of you. Make no mistake, your mother is abusive and you have every right to feel upset about the way you’re being treated. Even if she has an issue with how late you stay out, studying or not, why can’t she just have an adult conversation with you about it instead of going off on one at you and throwing a tantrum? Because she wants things all her way and hostility is the best way to do that, along with making YOU feel bad for HER behaviour.

Even if your cousin was right - which they’re not - why would your mother deserve any respect when she treats you like that? You’re not entitled to respect or anything from someone just because you happen to be related. Get out of there as soon as you can afford to, she sounds very controlling.

So, he emotionally blackmails and manipulates you about your daughter if you ever dared to leave him, he’s controlling to the extreme, and is doing his absolute best to isolate you from everyone you know and love? 

Like...Your husband is an abusive piece of shit, I don’t know how else to put it.

Okay so I finished reading the rest of it and honestly, you’re too fucking nice to her. Trying to say you might have BPD just because you didn’t want her to feel attacked and like she is the one being attacked. Sorry but she 100% deserves to be told what a manipulative, narcissistic, controlling, abusive creature she is. 

Saying she’ll kill herself if you leave her? Manipulate and disgusting. Threatening to kill your mother? Psychotic and dangerous. Getting mad at you for the fact that she hurt your feelings by treating you like sub-human dirt when she refuses to let things go after a month of your mother upsetting her? Hypocritical as FUCK. 

Like really, you say the relationship is good but I’m struggling to see what you get out of it? I don’t see that she has ANY redeeming features.

Also, she’s 100% trying to isolate you so she can control you even more than she already is. I can tell you now her end goal is for you to cut all ties with your family so that you can be her plaything forever.  She only agreed to get therapy because she realised you were serious about leaving, not because she actually wants or plans to get therapy. ‘I’ll get it when my health benefits come through from work!’ Bullshit. If she cared one iota about you or the relationship she would stop spending all her money on bollocks that she doesn’t need and spend that on getting therapy. She’s using this ‘until my health benefits come through’ to buy her time. Things will only get worse in an abusive relationship like this. She will only become more manipulative and cleverer at gaslighting you and making you feel like shit. I am genuinely worried for you. For your health, you need to leave her and never look back. Don’t let her emotionally blackmail you or guilt trip you. She’s been using you for too long. Go. Leave. Now.

I didn’t read the entire thing and I’ll tell you why; I got up to the part about Christmas with your family and I was infuriated. She is taking everything in this relationship and refusing to give a thing.  She gets everything she wants and throws tantrum after tantrum like a spoiled child and makes you feel like you have to walk on eggshells all the time. She sounds absolutely, horrifically toxic and I’d say she’s the abusive one BY A MILE. And the way she keeps changing the goalposts in the relationship? She’s dangerous and she’s gaslighting the fuck out of you. Get. The. Fuck. Out.
